headline: EXCITEBIKE: draw it, test-ride it — the bay learned to let go
lede: Design mode's missing half landed: a TEST tool seats your unfinished course for one unsaved lap, and Esc walks you straight back to the drafting table. The NES flow (save, then race) is untouched — this is the loop around it.

notes.text: #2587 shipped (c52a3c6): the TEST tool sits between BOOST and ERASE in the design bay. SPACE compiles your draft through the exact law SAVE reads — then seats one lap of your own terrain, rivals and all, with a TEST badge on screen and the leaderboard out of it.

The draft rides through a sentinel track alias, never the roster cache — so the splash menu never grows a phantom row, the shipped six courses stay byte-pinned, and Esc (or the finish line) restores the bay exactly where you left it. Proven: excitecheck 317/317 with all mutants dead, exciteplay 84/84 in real keys.
Slot b also holds ARENA ARCHERY #2579 (thick-ceiling underside hangs already live); its single-row half waits on jonq #2585 — a law-vs-tempo ruling, not a build task.
Honest remainder filed to QA: a phone can't Esc out of a test lap (ride it out), and splash-seated customs still use the save-and-race gate.
